lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice basic hypothetical reasoning for a local decision.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Discussing how a neighborhood could improve shared outdoor space.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Suggesting what could happen under a realistic condition and evaluating the effect.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a local proposal to add more benches and lighting near their building.

main_focus.name: hypothetical suggestion with om... skulle kunna
main_focus.description: Use a realistic condition and skulle kunna to discuss possible effects without sounding too certain.
model_examples: Om det fanns bättre belysning skulle fler känna sig trygga.
Vi skulle kunna föreslå fler bänkar vid lekplatsen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use hypothetical suggestion structures naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: advanced conditional patterns beyond realistic hypotheticals

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use neighborhood vocabulary with careful hypothetical suggestion chunks.

dialogue_shape.opening: A local improvement proposal is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss a realistic condition, possible positive effect, and one concern.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide whether to support the proposal or suggest a small change.

target_complexity.repetition: hypothetical forms should appear clearly but not dominate every sentence

focus: the possible benefit under the condition
the concern or adjustment before supporting it

sentence_focus: one sentence with om det fanns
one sentence describing a possible improvement
one sentence adding a concern with samtidigt
one sentence proposing a small adjustment
